purpose: Audit exactly one remaining train-only temporal mechanism without forcing another threshold, loss, interval-summary, or representation variant after v53 and v54 closed fresh-window and overlooked-candidate routes.

single_mechanism.name: causal station-layer exponential Hawkes anomaly-onset hazard
single_mechanism.scientific_fingerprint: For each station-layer, represent anomaly onsets as events and update a causal exponentially decayed sum of prior event impulses; use the resulting conditional-intensity state only on anchor-negative rows.

primary_source.title: Spectra of Some Self-Exciting and Mutually Exciting Point Processes
primary_source.author: Alan G. Hawkes
primary_source.claim_boundary: The source establishes the self-/mutually-exciting point-process mechanism. It does not establish P1 anomaly clustering, deployment observability, anomaly-detection benefit, or a competition score.

anchor_history_features.overlap: Existing causal features already encode time since the most recent anchor, signal run length, and lagged/rolling anchor probabilities. Replacing their finite memory with one exponential impulse sum changes the memory kernel, not the observable information source.

event_duration_and_decoder_family.overlap: These closed families already act on event timing, duration, and legal state transitions; a Hawkes hazard would add only another event-history decoder without a new measured state.

recurrence_and_return_time_family.overlap: Recurrence, laminar duration, extrema return time, and event proposals have already closed temporal recurrence/action geometry.

true_anomaly_onset_history.reason: Ground-truth anomaly onsets are the prediction target and cannot be consumed as a causal covariate when scoring an unlabeled deployment stream.

anchor_onset_substitute.reason: It is a deterministic memory-kernel transform of the same frozen anchor history already exposed through since-anchor, run-length, lagged probabilities, and event decoders.

candidate_registry_audit.finding: no overlooked promotable nonduplicate P1 candidate

decision.reason: The scientifically distinct Hawkes event stream would require past ground-truth anomaly onsets that do not exist at deployment. The only observable substitute is frozen anchor history, which repeats closed event-memory and recurrence information rather than adding a new state variable.
decision.minimum_new_evidence: A competition-allowed deployment-time event or maintenance stream independent of the predicted anomaly label, with authenticated timestamps and train/deployment coverage, or a genuinely fresh labeled chronological holdout paired with a new non-reconstructible observable.
